steps.title: The Opening Question
steps.content:
So {{contact_first_name}}, how has your skin been since your light treatment with us? I usually hear one of three things. It still looks clear and even, spots or redness are returning, or it's back to how it was. Which one is closest for you?

(Only three answers. Tap the one you hear.)

steps.title: Still Clear and Even
steps.content:
That's great to hear, {{contact_first_name}}. Your notes say you were happy with how it turned out. Is it nice not to think about those spots or redness?

(Let them answer.)

steps.title: Starting to Come Back
steps.content:
That happens, {{contact_first_name}}. Skin keeps changing, especially with new sun exposure. It's not anything you did wrong. What kept you from coming back in?

(Let them answer. Stay warm. Do not book yet.)

steps.title: Back to How It Was
steps.content:
I'm sorry to hear that, {{contact_first_name}}. Skin keeps changing, and new sun exposure can bring spots back. What kept you from coming back in?

(Let them answer. Stay warm. Do not book yet.)

steps.title: Ask Permission for the Questions
steps.content:
{{contact_first_name}}, I'm updating your file anyway. Can I ask a few questions about anything else you've noticed?

(Wait for the yes.)

steps.title: The Transition: Ask Permission
steps.content:
{{contact_first_name}}, you said the spots or redness are returning. We'll come back to that. First, can I ask a few questions so your file is up to date?

(Wait for the yes.)

steps.title: The Questions: Update the File
steps.content:
(Write down every concern they name. Recap them in a moment.)

Are any sun spots or brown spots showing up?

How about redness or flushing?

Do you notice any small red veins?

Does your skin tone look uneven anywhere?

Any spots on your chest or hands?

Have any fine lines been bothering you?

Has your skin looked rough or dull lately?

Have you been dealing with breakouts?

How is your home skincare routine going?

(Recap what you wrote down, then ask:)

{{contact_first_name}}, of those, which one bothers you the most?

(Tap their answer below.)

steps.title: The Questions: Update the File
steps.content:
(Write down every concern they name, including the first one.)

Are any sun spots or brown spots showing up?

How about redness or flushing?

Do you notice any small red veins?

Does your skin tone look uneven anywhere?

Any spots on your chest or hands?

Have any fine lines been bothering you?

Has your skin looked rough or dull lately?

Have you been dealing with breakouts?

How is your home skincare routine going?

(Recap everything, including what they mentioned first, then ask:)

{{contact_first_name}}, between these concerns, which one bothers you the most?

(Tap their answer below.)

steps.title: Making It Real
steps.content:
{{contact_first_name}}, I'd like to ask about {{main_concern}} so your file is up to date.

(Ask each question in order. Pause after each answer.)

How long has that been on your mind?

(Let them answer. Repeat it back.)

Is it something you notice now and then, or most days?

(Let them answer.)

When it bothers you, how does it affect how you feel about your skin?

(Let them answer. Do not rush.)

Thank you for sharing that.

steps.title: The Review
steps.content:
{{contact_first_name}}, let me make sure I have this right.

(Recap how long, how often, and how it affects them.)

Did I get that right?

It sounds like you'd like to feel comfortable with your skin again. Is that fair to say?

(Tap what you hear.)

steps.title: The Recommendation
steps.content:
{{contact_first_name}}, can I make a recommendation?

(Wait for the yes.)

Let's get you in so {{provider_name}} can look at {{main_concern}}. If we can help, we'll tell you. If it's not the right fit, we'll tell you that too. Does that sound reasonable?

(Tap what you hear.)

steps.title: They Hesitate: Find Out Why
steps.content:
{{contact_first_name}}, you said {{main_concern}} has been on your mind. I don't want to assume anything. Is timing the issue, or is something else holding you back?

(Stay easy about it. Let them answer.)

steps.title: Nothing Found: Why Did They Stop?
steps.content:
{{contact_first_name}}, I'm glad your skin still looks clear and even.

Can I ask what changed that led you to stop coming in?

(Let them answer. Do not argue with it.)

Skin keeps changing, and new sun exposure can bring spots or redness back. Does that make sense?

(Wait for the yes.)

Can I make a recommendation?

(Wait for the yes.)

Let's get you in for a check so we can see how your skin looks now. Does that sound reasonable?

steps.title: Objection: “The spots came right back”
steps.content:
I understand why that would be frustrating. New sun exposure can affect how skin looks over time. A visit lets us see what's happening now and talk it through.

Can we get you in for a look?

steps.title: Objection: “I didn’t see enough of a difference”
steps.content:
I appreciate you telling me. That's the kind of thing we'd want to discuss in person. {{provider_name}} can hear what you hoped for and look at your skin now.

(Do not promise results.)

Is there anything else on your mind?

steps.title: Objection: “I’m nervous about the peeling and dark spots afterward”
steps.content:
That's fair. It's a good thing to talk through in person before deciding anything. We can listen to your concerns and answer your questions.

Would it help to come in and talk it through first?

steps.title: Objection: “I went somewhere else”
steps.content:
That's okay, {{contact_first_name}}. Your history with us is still here. We can look at where things stand now without making assumptions.

(Do not ask why they left.)

Would you be open to coming back in?

steps.title: If They Say: “My skin looked good”
steps.content:
That makes sense, {{contact_first_name}}. When your skin looks good, coming back can feel less urgent. New sun exposure can change things over time.

Was anything else holding you back, or was that pretty much it?

(If they name another reason, go back and tap it.)

Can I make a recommendation?

(Wait for the yes.)

Let's get you back on the schedule for a look. Does that sound reasonable?

steps.title: If They Say: Cost or Budget
steps.content:
I understand, {{contact_first_name}}. A check is just a look. You're not committing to anything.

Does that seem fair?

(Do not discuss prices, packages, or discounts.)

Was anything else holding you back, or was that pretty much it?

(If they name another reason, go back and tap it.)

Can I make a recommendation?

(Wait for the yes.)

Let's get you back on the schedule for a look. Does that sound reasonable?

steps.title: If They Say: “Life got busy”
steps.content:
I hear you, {{contact_first_name}}. Life fills up fast, and skin care gets pushed down the list. We can find a visit time that works around your schedule.

Would that work?

Was anything else holding you back, or was that pretty much it?

(If they name another reason, go back and tap it.)

Can I make a recommendation?

(Wait for the yes.)

Let's get you back on the schedule at an easy time. Does that sound reasonable?

steps.title: If They Say: “I’ll come back when the spots return”
steps.content:
That's a fair way to think about it, {{contact_first_name}}. A quick look can catch small changes before they become more noticeable.

Does that sound fair?

Was anything else holding you back, or was that pretty much it?

(If they name another reason, go back and tap it.)

Can I make a recommendation?

(Wait for the yes.)

Let's get you back on the schedule for a look. Does that sound reasonable?

steps.title: If They Say: They Moved or Went Elsewhere
steps.content:
That's understandable, {{contact_first_name}}. Things change. If you're nearby, we'd be glad to see you again. Your history is still in your file.

Would that be okay?

Was anything else holding you back, or was that pretty much it?

(If they name another reason, go back and tap it.)

Can I make a recommendation?

(Wait for the yes.)

Let's get you back on the schedule. Does that sound reasonable?

steps.title: Objection: “I need to think about it”
steps.content:
That's fair, {{contact_first_name}}. What part would you like to think over?

(Listen. Tap the matching concern if they name one.)

A visit gives you information about your skin now. Then you can decide with real answers.

Does that help?

steps.title: Objection: “Just send me some info”
steps.content:
I'd be glad to send information, {{contact_first_name}}. General information can't show what's happening with your skin. That's what an in-person look is for.

Could we set up that visit first?
